title: Dialogues
subtitle: B2 · Unit 11: B2 · TCF speaking Task 2: get the information you need

steps.title: Dialogues
steps.body: Listen for the speakers' goals and how each response changes the exchange. Read once for meaning, then cover the English and summarize each person's position.

steps.title: Ask about a community workshop
steps.body: The notice is fictional. The learner has two minutes to prepare and then asks the coordinator questions.

examples.fr: Bonjour, je vous appelle au sujet de l'atelier de samedi.
examples.en: Participant: Hello, I am calling about Saturday's workshop.
Coordonnatrice: Hello. What would you like to know?

examples.fr: Pourriez-vous préciser l'horaire et le tarif ?
examples.en: Participant: Could you clarify the schedule and price?

examples.fr: L'atelier commence à dix heures. Le matériel de base est compris.
examples.en: Coordonnatrice: The workshop begins at ten. Basic materials are included.
Participant: What do you mean by basic materials?

examples.fr: Les outils sont fournis; les participants apportent leurs notes.
examples.en: Coordonnatrice: Tools are provided; participants bring their notes.

examples.fr: Y a-t-il une autre date si je ne peux pas venir samedi ?
examples.en: Participant: Is there another date if I cannot come Saturday?

examples.fr: Une séance aura lieu le mois prochain, sous réserve de disponibilité.
examples.en: Coordonnatrice: A session will take place next month, subject to availability.

examples.fr: Si j'ai bien compris, je dois confirmer ma place par courriel.
examples.en: Participant: If I understood correctly, I need to confirm my place by email.

examples.fr: Exactement. Je vous enverrai les détails.
examples.en: Coordonnatrice: Exactly. I will send you the details.

steps.title: Following an incomplete answer
steps.body: The coordinator gives a partial answer; the learner asks a relevant follow-up.

examples.fr: Est-ce que l'inscription comprend le matériel ?
examples.en: Awa: Does registration include the materials?

examples.fr: Elle comprend les outils de base.
examples.en: Agent: It includes the basic tools.

examples.fr: Et les frais de transport sont-ils inclus ?
examples.en: Awa: And are transportation costs included?

examples.fr: Non, ils restent à la charge des participants.
examples.en: Agent: No, participants are responsible for those.

examples.fr: Merci. Pourriez-vous me dire à qui écrire si je dois annuler ?
examples.en: Awa: Thank you. Could you tell me whom to write to if I need to cancel?

examples.fr: L'adresse de contact figure au bas de la confirmation.
examples.en: Agent: The contact address appears at the bottom of the confirmation.
